outcome: Intrapartum presentation change from cephalic to noncephalic presentation after mechanical cervical ripening
cohort: 3,462 women with fetal cephalic confirmed position on admission undergoing induction of labor with mechanical cervical ripening
finding: Nulliparity and multifetal gestation are associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery for intrapartum presentation change after mechanical cervical ripening.
gest_age: All gestational ages, with a subgroup analysis of women less than 34 weeks' gestation
